issues.display_title: Issue #59: Create Wizard Step 3 — Set Floor UI Layout
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Step 3 of the Wizard: the user configures each Level (Floor) auto-created from their uploaded images. They can rename each Level, set wall height, add extra rows, remove rows, and reorder rows via drag-and-drop. The existing Figma frame (node-id=1-963) covers the default row state but is missing drag handles, error states, and the empty-list state. This task fills those gaps.

issues.display_title: Issue #60: Create Wizard Step 4 — Generate: Scan Wall & Area UI Layout
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Step 4 of the Wizard: the AI processes each Level sequentially — first scanning wall polylines, then scanning area boundaries per uploaded Floor Plan image. The current Figma frame (node-id=1-1116) is a placeholder. This task is the most design-intensive step: it requires a full real-time progress UI with per-Level status rows, error and retry states, and the final Download / Open in Editor actions.
